description: Pycha, the spirit of pride: a huge floating golden mask of a haughty face, one wide shape filling the whole picture, its nose raised high, half-closed disdainful eyes looking down, a thin sneering mouth, a tall crown of sharp golden spikes on top, long purple ribbons streaming down from it, no body, no hands, an abstract creature, a bold simple silhouette filling the whole picture, few big readable shapes, strong light and dark contrast, a crisp dark outline, little fine detail, menacing, floating, full body, the mask alone, no ground, no background, the whole mask inside the picture
